findings.description: The queue helper checks the topic head and stored preflight head/tree but does not verify preflight mode/trusted_base or fresh remote main against the reviewed base immediately before admission. A main advance after preflight can be admitted; later cleanup and hosted audit detect parent/tree mismatch only after merge.
findings.correction: Require mode=preflight, trusted_base equal commit receipt base, matching successful commands/log and a fresh read-only remote main/base equality observation immediately before enqueue; retain that observation in the queue receipt. A subsequent concurrent update remains a native queue race.
findings.acceptance: Inspect revised guard, compile helper, exercise the guard in an isolated mocked command harness with matching and changed base and mismatched preflight identity; no live enqueue required for this regression.
